## Eligibility or scoring impact

- [ ] No impact
- [ ] Confirmed official eligibility
- [ ] Working MVP eligibility rule
- [ ] Recommendation-model assumption

If the feature changes eligibility, provide the exact official source URL, admission year, last-verified date, and any uncertainty. If it changes scoring, explain that the weights are model assumptions and not official university admission weightages.

## Privacy, security, and cost

Would this feature collect or store student data, require authentication, add a database, use an external service, or create a cost? Explain why and list simpler alternatives.

Supabase, authentication, external AI APIs, OCR, and paid services are outside the current MVP scope unless separately approved.
